---
title: "R Notebook"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
library(datasets)
data(mtcars)

head(mtcars, 5)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

#create a scatterplot of displacement (disp) and miles per gallon (mpg)

ggplot(aes(x=disp, y=mpg,), data=mtcars) + geom_point()
```

```{r}
#add a title
ggplot(aes(x=disp, y=mpg,), data=mtcars) + geom_point()+ggtitle("displacement vs miles per gallon") + labs(x="displacement", y="miles per galon")

```

```{r}
#CREATION D'UNE BOITE A MOUSTACHE(boxplot)
#convert vs as a factor because it represent the type of the motor and is not a numerical variable 
mtcars$vs = as.factor(mtcars$vs)

ggplot(aes(x=disp, y=mpg,), data=mtcars)+geom_boxplot()

```

```{r}
ggplot(aes(x=vs, y=mpg, fill = vs), data = mtcars) + 
  geom_boxplot(alpha=0.3) +
  theme(legend.position="none")
```

```{r}
ggplot(aes(x=wt),data=mtcars) + geom_histogram(binwidth=0.5)
```
